page_title: Alter Ego | One memory for every AI chat

sources.entry: Alter Ego - One memory for all your AI chats, in Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and any other AI chat, logged automatically and kept in your own cloud storage. #mcp #memory

summary.name: Alter Ego
summary.one_liner: A remote MCP connector that gives all your AI chats one persistent memory of your rules, profile and work history, stored as plain files in your own cloud storage.
use_cases: Carry context and rules across Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini chats
Pick up ongoing client work where a previous chat left off
Keep an automatic log of AI chat progress in your own files
Store personal preferences and rules once for every AI assistant
Track invoices and follow-ups across sessions
summary.what_it_does: Alter Ego is a remote MCP connector that AI chats can use to read and write a shared memory. It stores your rules, profile, contexts and playbooks, and opens a context (such as a client project) so a new chat can pick up the latest README and journal entries. Commands shown on the page include remember, which saves a fact to a context, and log, which records what was done. Entries are kept as plain files in your own cloud storage rather than in the vendor's database. The page says it works with OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, GitHub and Azure DevOps as storage backends.
notable: Plain files stored in the user's own cloud storage (OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, GitHub, Azure DevOps)
Works in any AI chat that supports MCP connectors, including Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini
Chats are logged automatically and context is opened per project (e.g. a client)
Commands such as open_context, remember and log manage the memory
caveats: Requires an AI chat that supports MCP connectors
Pricing is not stated on the page
